BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has announced the purchase of 1,777,593 ordinary shares on 6 July 2026 for an average price of 228.93 pence per share, 1,777,593 ordinary shares on 7 July 2026 for an average price of 232.83 pence per share, 1,777,593 ordinary shares on 8 July 2026 for an average price of 230.36 pence per share, 1,777,593 ordinary shares on 9 July 2026 for an average price of 229.85 pence per share, and 1,777,593 ordinary shares on 10 July 2026 for an average price of 225.94 pence per share, as part of its share buyback program. Following these transactions, the company has 979,092,511 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares, with a total of 23,653,503 ordinary shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights, excluding treasury shares, is 979,092,511 as of 10 July 2026. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 10 July 2026 10 July 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
